plan: turn (game/probe/unit_probe.py TURN_*; tmp/tactic_slice/review_attack_v23.md L, the orchestrator's order of 15.11 night)
what: At once or in turn against an enemy that beats the anvil, every unit with its morale (no fearless flags; the parked lords only). E (Skaven) attacks our anvil A (Empire spearmen_0, an extra, never ordered) at a run from 200 m front to front; our free unit B (Empire swordsmen) stands on A's line 90 m aside (centres), facing E's side. now: B attacks E at a run 8 s after A's first melee flag (the drill's teacher); turn: B not ordered while A fights; solo: no B. In now and turn, once A routs (routing, shattered or dead - the Lua entry's new t_go_rout_of / a_go_rout_of 'e1'), E is ordered to attack B at a run and in turn B to attack E, E's order first (in now too: an attack order on the enemy a unit touches zeroes its break-off timer, reverse/notes/melee_turn.md 2.5; without it E would chase the routed A and give B its back); in solo E's order on A stands (the chase). Strengths: s E = stormvermin_1 ('the anvil is doomed'), m E = clanrats_1 ('even'). A lane ends 480 s after its contact or 'quiet' (a side out - each of its units routing, shattered or dead - and no melee flag in the lane for 30 s: the entry's new quiet_end_s). 16 battles: now_s, turn_s, now_m, turn_m and one solo (s odd, m even battles) rotated over 5 places in one row along x 400 m apart (routers flee along z); every B of a battle on one side, mirrored between battles; the lords parked below the row; 16 units, 1,882 men (the 100 ms engine step); no memory rows.
measures: By lane, from the unit rows every 0.25 s (game/probe/unit_probe.py turn_measure): c0 = the lane's first melee flag (A's or E's); each unit's share of its starting health lost from the sample before c0 to c0 + 120 / 240 / 300 / 480 s and to the lane's end (a window past the end reads the end; the twin, which runs on, ends by the entry's rule on its rows); trade = (E's share x E's cost - the sum of ours) / the mean of the two sides' cost (multiplayer_cost: spearmen 300, swordsmen 375, stormvermin_1 850, clanrats_1 350; net/stage0/watch.py hp_trade, no credit for a rout); gtrade the gold form (sim/reward.py lost_now with its worst so far: dead, shattered or gone 1, routing + 0.5 of the rest); first rout, first rally (end of a rout not shattered), s from c0. now - turn by strength: the difference of the means over lanes, se = root of the two squares (unpaired: kinds stand on different places); beside it paired by battle (each battle has one now and one turn lane of a strength). 'Two errors' = 2 se.

decision.D1_s: strength (s): now - turn of trade at the lane's end above zero by two errors -> in the game 'at once' is right even when the anvil is doomed: the simulator's nil (the analyst's -0.029 +- 0.023 on the scenes' 'anvil routs in both arms' stratum) is its fault and goes to the melee core's list; within two errors of zero or below -> the simulator's reading stands: the drill's label is not supported in that stratum and 'keep the free unit back when the anvil is lost' becomes a candidate technique. Read beside: 300 s and the gold form (not deciding).
decision.D2_m: strength (m): the same read (trade at the lane's end, now - turn, two errors); expected positive by the manual (concentrate; units sent in one by one are beaten in turn); a nil or below here puts the drill's cause itself in question in the game - reported loudly.
decision.D3_beside: stated, not deciding: the relief - A's rout time now minus turn, s; E's rout time now against turn; solo's A rout time and E's loss then.

strength_choice.how: HEAD twin (the tree's sim at 9704ec5 + this change's twin orders), the plan's own places, battles 1-4 (both B sides, both solos), 8 copies a lane: python -m tmp.probe_night3.choose (CPU container agent-pb); candidates s: stormvermin_1 / stormvermin_0, m: clanrats_1 / clanrats_0 / clanrat_spearmen_0
strength_choice.rule: (s): A routs in now and in turn in most lanes and E then beats or nearly beats B; (m): solo's A routs, now's A + B rout E, and turn's A routs early enough for B's fight to be read before 480 s
strength_choice.why: s stormvermin_1: A routs in every now and turn lane (215 / 202 s), B then routs too (353 / 417 s), E never routs - doomed, with E's real chance against B (stormvermin_0 the same, a little slower: 229 / 215 s). m clanrats_1: solo's A routs at 259 s, now routs E at 296 s with A routing in 0.19 of lanes, turn's A routs at 261 s and B routs E at 353 s; clanrats_0 the same within a few s; clanrat_spearmen_0 too slow (solo's A routs at 338 s, turn's E at 442 s - the read would brush the 480 s end).

The decision lines and the twins' predictions stand as written (the twin has no clamp: its lanes are the plan's geometry).

verdict.D1_s: THE SIMULATOR'S NIL STANDS. strength s (stormvermin_1 against spearmen_0 + swordsmen): now - turn of trade at the lane's end +0.007 +- 0.011 (21 / 20 lanes; paired by battle +0.017 +- 0.014, 17) - inside two errors of zero; gold +0.011 +- 0.010. At 300 s 'at once' is WORSE: -0.038 +- 0.013 (2.8 errors), at 120 s better +0.036 +- 0.007. Both kinds lose the lane alike (trade_end -0.414 / -0.421): E never routs, B routs in every lane. The drill's label is not supported when the anvil is doomed; 'keep the free unit back when the anvil is lost' becomes a candidate technique. Twins: HEAD +0.141, S1 +0.245 - both far too optimistic: in the game E loses 0.377 (now) / 0.357 (turn) of its health by the end, the twins 0.75 / 0.61 (HEAD) - the twins' stormvermin_1 are too soft against Empire infantry; for the melee core's list.
verdict.D2_m: AT ONCE IS RIGHT, AS THE MANUAL SAYS. strength m (clanrats_1): now - turn of trade at the end +0.218 +- 0.027 (22 / 20; paired +0.188 +- 0.026, 18), 8 errors above zero; 300 s +0.280 +- 0.023; gold end +0.267 +- 0.023. now: E routs at 246 +- 6 s in every lane, A never routs (0 / 22); turn: A routs at 307 +- 11 s (19 / 20), then B routs E at 402 +- 5 s (17 / 20). The drill's cause holds in the game where the pair can win. Twins: HEAD -0.033 (the sign wrong: a joiner adds no damage in HEAD), S1 +0.104 (the right sign, half the game's).
verdict.D3_beside: Relief: A routs later with B on E by +54 +- 13 s in s (220 against 166 s; paired +57 +- 10) and not at all in m (0 / 22 now against 19 / 20 turn at 307 s). E's rout: m now 246 +- 6 s against turn 402 +- 5 s (-156 +- 8); s: E never routs in either. B's rout in s: now 310 +- 5 s, turn 361 +- 6 s (B fights longer in now and loses everything either way). Solo: s A routs at 171 +- 10 s with E down 0.056 +- 0.003; m A routs at 317 +- 17 s with E down 0.325 +- 0.008 (the twins: 197 s / 0.121 and 259 s / 0.331).
